value:
Security advisory on a TRANSITIVE dep (e.g. fast-uri under ajv under MCP SDK): neither `bun update <pkg>` nor `bun install --force` dedupes the nested lockfile resolution — bun preserves existing nested entries while the constraint is still satisfiable, so the old vulnerable version keeps loading at runtime.

FIX: (1) add the safe version to `overrides` in package.json (NOT dependencies — don't take a maintenance contract for a dep you never import); (2) `rm bun.lock && bun install` — only a from-scratch resolve dedupes, --force does NOT; (3) verify with `grep '"fast-uri@' bun.lock` → exactly one entry.

CAVEAT: a fresh resolve also bumps OTHER deps within caret ranges. If that's not acceptable, do it on a throwaway branch and diff first (PR #113 accepted the wider bump). Discovered 2026-05-08, PR #113 / GHSA-v39h-62p7-jpjc.
